name: oss-issue-proof
description: Windows-only Codex maintenance evidence and verification Skill.

interface.longDescription: Skills-only plugin for supported Windows 10/11 hosts. With a separately installed issue-proof CLI, it guides explicit baseline reproduction, Codex JSONL import, same-argv independent verification, and redacted draft receipts. Tested with Python 3.11, 3.12, and 3.14. Linux and macOS are unsupported, untested, and unverified. It does not post, push, publish, start Codex, or read private Codex state.
defaultPrompt: Use the separately installed issue-proof CLI on Windows to reproduce an OSS issue, verify the same argv, and draft a receipt.
